text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, everyone. That was certainly
not the performance I
wanted to give.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, why the heck are you
apologizin'? You're making it sound
like
you've crimed us or somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And the Japan Cup is just a bonkers race,
yeah? Finishin' fourth with
all the other
stars out there is pretty dang respectable.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She's right! I was just as enraptured with
your running today as I have
ever been!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Plus, no crazy incidents happened today.
Our trainer here's definitely
gonna treat ya
to somethin' nice, right?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, yeah! That's right! Let's go stuff
our faces, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, yeah! That's right! Let's go stuff
our faces, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I... must politely decline.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have the Arima Kinen to prepare for, and
I'm not even hungry,
having just finished a
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and I must make a call to
Grandmother. Please go ahead without

me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone... I am so, so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess that wasn't very convincing... You
too, though. You suck at
acting!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. It took me a second to catch on, but
I tried...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. It took me a second to catch on, but
I tried...

When McQueen fled the room, I wasn't
sure whether to go after her
or give her
some space—a moment of indecision I'm
already
regretting.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if it isn't Oguri! Didja come out to
cheer for McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I owe this team a lot, and I
heard its brightest star would
be running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But where is that star, might I ask?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It seems something happened here.
Will you tell me about it?

I tell Oguri Cap everything that transpired
since she departed from
the team.

I tell Oguri Cap everything that transpired
since she departed from
the team.

About how we were in danger of being
disbanded, and how we were
able to
overcome that by recruiting new members.

About the embarrassment McQueen had
suffered at the autumn
Tenno Sho, and her
attempt to redeem herself today—only to
place
fourth.

I explain how everything keeps failing to
come together for Mejiro
McQueen, no
matter how she tries to make the pieces
fit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see. I can sympathize with her quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She's convinced herself that she has to live
up to every expectation
of her.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You think so?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I went through the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Good results breed expectations, and
before you know it, you've
bound yourself
to meet those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Soon, they all start to feel like obstacles in
your path.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Obstacles... I see.

The only reason this team is still around is
because Mejiro McQueen
was there for us.

Everyone looks up to her... aspires to be
like her.

And it's not just the other runners. I piled
on the pressure with every
victory, too.

And it's not just the other runners. I piled
on the pressure with every
victory, too.

It's obvious now that she has been
struggling with everything riding
on her
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer, perhaps you could find a way
to turn those obstacles into
a source of
power.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: From obstacles to power...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, how did the old man go about
helping you do that?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, how did the old man go about
helping you do that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm, I suppose I could tell you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But it's just what worked for us. You and
McQueen have your own
special bond.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think you'd best approach it in a way that
works for you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: The bond that McQueen and I share...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: The bond that McQueen and I share...

I have none of the skill or charisma that my
mentor possessed, yet
McQueen still
trusted me to be her trainer.

I have none of the skill or charisma that my
mentor possessed, yet
McQueen still
trusted me to be her trainer.

Just why did she choose to place her faith
in me? What can I do now
in her hour of
need?

Just why did she choose to place her faith
in me? What can I do now
in her hour of
need?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no hesitation at all. That part of you
hasn't changed at all from
your assistant
trainer days.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Always putting us first...

That's it. That's what I need to do. I need
to stand by her side, and
offer her my faith
and support.

That's it. That's what I need to do. I need
to stand by her side, and
offer her my faith
and support.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mmkay. Well, I guess I'll go loiter around
the academy road and near
the station.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll go see if she went back to the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And I'll go looking around the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she went to the shrine? I'll drop by
and check!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Our team's ace needs us now more than
ever!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Our team's ace needs us now more than
ever!
